author: meta_alchemist
text:
Kimi 2.7 may be the release that will bring competition to Claude Fable 5, at a price everyone can afford

Here is how

Cursor has been using Kimi 2.5 in their RL to perfect it with Composer 2 & 2.5

When I fed the research that Cursor team achieved via RLing Kimi again, this time projecting it for Kimi 2.7, the numbers that GPT 5.5 estimated were these in the chart

Bare in mind it said it didn't scale the gains as much, but made a fair estimation because they were already reaching high end scores where RL gains would be a bit more diminished

If Cursor comes out with a model using Kimi 2.7 we will likely see a model 20-30x cheaper than Fable 5, with not too much noticeable difference in coding scenarios

Could be the Fable of people, as Fable will be only usable via credits after 22nd of this month. Which 99% of people won't wanna pay.

author: meta_alchemist
text:
Almost every week, Higgsfield releases something dope, which made me a frequent user of the platform to get creative work done.

Their new integration is about vibe coding games, using Claude Fable 5, with the Higgsfield MCP, so you can generate your environments, UI elements, sprites, cut-scenes, and much more...

Directly from Claude's interface, where Higgsfield is helping you to generate things that Claude can't, making them a perfect team.

Making a hit game is very possible even for solo devs, as we've seen with Schedule 1, which smoked most AAA games last year, without AI.

With generative AI removing barriers now, many new solo and small-game teams will vibe code their way to very successful games.

I will be building some games too, as it's fun af.
